wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, has this market found its Muse?

wsjHeadlines.title: AI and Chip Stocks Race Ahead
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Paramount settles and crude prices drop again

wsjHeadlines.title: Africa Digs Up Tons of Illicit Gold. A Fabled Refinery Wants to Make It Legit.
wsjHeadlines.description: The century-old Rand Refinery, long the go-to destination for Africa’s commercially mined gold, is trying to integrate often-problematic artisanal gold into its supply.

wsjHeadlines.title: Auto Parts Retailers Can Turn the Corner
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, a week for diplomacy.

wsjHeadlines.title: A Safer Way to Bet on Nuclear
wsjHeadlines.description: There are a lot of wild nuclear bets in the market. One enrichment company holds a strong hand.

wsjHeadlines.title: Don’t Count Out Corporate Bonds Just Because the Fed Is Raising Rates
wsjHeadlines.description: A healthy economy and reduced issuance by tech companies could support corporate debt.

wsjHeadlines.title: Meta’s AI Agent Has a Trust Problem
wsjHeadlines.description: The company’s Muse AI agent needs user data to be useful, but users might be wary.

wsjHeadlines.title: Saudi Arabia Has Another Option to Get Its Oil Out
wsjHeadlines.description: A shuttle service that slips oil through the Strait of Hormuz now looks like the kingdom’s best fallback.

wsjHeadlines.title: Trump Administration Shift Puts This Corner of Biotech Back in Favor
wsjHeadlines.description: With the Food and Drug Administration’s hard-liners gone, investors are rushing back into rare-disease bets.

wsjHeadlines.title: Societe Generale Shares Climb After Bank Raises Profitability Target
wsjHeadlines.description: Shares rose 4%, taking the stock’s year-to-date gain to nearly 10%, after the bank said it is cutting costs and growing revenue to boost profitability through the end of the decade, including widening its use of AI.

wsjHeadlines.title: New Report on SVB Collapse Pins Blame on Fed’s Own Regulators, Fed Official Says
wsjHeadlines.description: The report, commissioned by Trump ally Michelle Bowman, blamed bank-supervision staff in the Biden era.

wsjHeadlines.description: Mynt is entering the IPO market amid heightened uncertainty in global markets.

wsjHeadlines.title: Truist to Sell $5.5 Billion of Loans as It Exits Near-Prime Auto Lending
wsjHeadlines.description: Truist Financial has inked a deal to sell $5.5 billion of auto loans as part of the regional bank’s decision to exit the near-prime auto lending business.

wsjHeadlines.title: Investors Demand Highest Yield at Two-Year U.S. Treasury Auction Since 2024
wsjHeadlines.description: The auction, which saw the notes sell at a yield of 4.787%, comes as investors brace for rising interest rates after hawkish communication from Federal Reserve officials  followed a rate increase last week.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech-Stocks Rise as Oil Sinks Below $100
wsjHeadlines.description: The Nasdaq Composite Index was poised for a second straight record high as falling oil prices helped U.S. tech stocks stay buoyant.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Utilities to Gain From Higher Natural Gas Prices
wsjHeadlines.description: A basket of European utilities stocks rose and Bank of America said European utilities’ earnings will benefit from higher-for-longer natural gas prices on the continent.

wsjHeadlines.title: Smiths Group Shares Rise After Better-Than-Expected Results
wsjHeadlines.description: The  industrial-engineering company was one of the top gainers in the FTSE 100 index after it projected an acceleration in top-line growth for the year ahead.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Prices Gain as Hopes Fade for U.S.-Iran Talks
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices rose on fading optimism about talks between the U.S. and Iran at this week’s United Nations meeting, while Asian equities inched higher as artificial-intelligence sentiment strengthened.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Dangers of Fractional-Reserve Banking
wsjHeadlines.description: The ‘money-on-demand’ system is fragile and high risk.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Don’t Expand Payroll Taxes for Social Security
wsjHeadlines.description: Lifting the payroll tax cap would harm the broader economy.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Bessent Predicament
wsjHeadlines.description: The smart fix for the Treasury secretary is to dump tariffs and encourage free trade.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Staring Contest Over the Dollar and the Yen
wsjHeadlines.description: Or is it a circular firing squad among Bessent, Tokyo and investors?

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | You Probably Have the Iran War Backward
wsjHeadlines.description: The blockade proves the success of sanctions. If the U.S. keeps its chokehold, Tehran will likely break.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The SEC’s Big and Welcome Proxy Reform
wsjHeadlines.description: The agency wants to stop telling companies how to handle shareholder resolutions.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures Extend Decline to Five Sessions
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures extended their losing streak to five sessions on optimism about oil flows out of the Middle East with Saudi Arabia set to restore its damaged pipeline while dark transits continue through the Strait of Hormuz.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Futures Slip As U.S. Dollar Gains
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures settled modestly lower as the U.S. dollar firmed and yields edged up, while finding some support in lower oil prices that if sustained could ease inflation pressures.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Regain Ground
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures recovered much of Monday’s losses as softening production readings and a pickup in LNG feedgas helped offset declining weather-driven demand.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on gold futures, Artemis Gold,  NexGen Energy and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials .

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Retreat on Cooling Weather
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures gave back most of last week’s gains as the heat than has kept up power-sector demand is set to dissipate.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Little Moved by Pullback in Energy Prices
wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar traded nearly flat, little moved by pullback in energy prices.

wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index rose 0.1% — up five of the past six trading days.
